description: This file defines a StatelessWorker grain class for Orleans, which produces messages to a stream. It includes class and method definitions related to stream production in a Orleans-based distributed system.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerStreamProducerGrain
classes.description: A grain class that produces messages to an Orleans stream, marked as StatelessWorker with a maximum of one local worker.

methods.name: Produce
methods.description: Asynchronously produces a message to a specified Orleans stream identified by streamId and provider.
